english.title: Theft from a meter / automatic machine
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), stole **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY..),

(A)_[to the value of **(..SPECIFY THE VALUE..),]_
(B)_[of a value unknown,]_

belonging to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) and 7 of the Theft Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
dishonestly
appropriated property
belonging to another
from a meter / automatic machine
with the intention of
permanently depriving the other of it

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Mandatory drug test required if 18 or over
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required where the offence involves theft of spouse's property.

consent.description: DPP's consent required when spouse's property involved

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
